::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
TI Bengaluru is one of the longest-running semiconductor design centres in India, operational since 1985. It is a full chip design centre, not just a support office.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Analog and mixed-signal ICs, power management chips, embedded microcontrollers (MSP430, C2000 series), and industrial interface chips. Bengaluru handles complete chip ownership from concept to production.
